title: SILVERHÖJDEN Frame
description: SILVERHÖJDEN Frame, gold, 12x16". Decorate with pictures you love. This frame has a matt metal-like finish and comes in many sizes, perfect for a picture wall.
features: This frame fits with a picture that has dimensions 8¼x11¾" if you use it with the mat, and it fits with a picture that has dimensions 12¼x16⅛" if you choose to use the frame without the mat.
The mat will not turn yellow since it is acid-free.
Different wall materials require different types of fasteners. Use fasteners suitable for the walls in your home.
materialAndCare: Mat: Paper; Frame: Fiberboard, Paper foil; Front protection: Polystyrene
